ClarifyGo recording uses the Microsoft Graph API to record calls, meetings and screen-sharing on Teams, including both internal and external conversations. It upholds all major compliance standards, as well as supporting performance improvement and business development through AI and quality analysis tools. [...] With remote installation, ClarifyGo can get you up and running with compliant call recording in under 30 minutes, minimizing downtime and allowing you to harness the benefits of Teams call recording swiftly.
